surprises.description: FY2026 adjusted EBITDA was $4.1 million, below the preview’s roughly $4.9 million estimate. That is a noticeable shortfall from the modeled result.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Full year adjusted EBITDA increased 134.2% to $4.1 million.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview modeled FY2026 adjusted EBITDA at “~$4.9M.”

surprises.description: FY2026 revenue was above the preview’s $30.4 million consensus, but slightly below its $31.85 million base estimate. The result beat the published bar while landing just under the preview’s own forecast.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Full year fiscal 2026 consolidated revenue increased 7.6% to $31.6 million.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview listed FY26 consensus of “$30.4M” and a base estimate of “$31.85M.”

surprises.description: Q4 revenue exceeded the $7.25 million published consensus and fell within the preview’s $7.7–8.1 million whisper range, but was below its $7.95 million base estimate. It was a beat against consensus, but not against the preview’s central forecast.
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview cited Q4 consensus of “$7.25M,” a base estimate of “$7.95M,” and a “$7.7–8.1M” realistic whisper range.

surprises.description: FY2026 non-GAAP net income per diluted share was $0.24, above the $0.20 consensus but below the preview’s $0.27 base estimate. It therefore beat the published estimate without reaching the preview’s own forecast.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Non-GAAP net income rose to $3.1 million ($0.24 per diluted share).”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview listed FY26 EPS consensus of “$0.20 (likely non-GAAP)” and a base estimate of “$0.27 non-GAAP.”

surprises.description: Marketplace ARPU reached $0.121, below the preview’s expected ARPMAU of about $0.127. The reported 30.5% year-over-year increase was strong, but the level was short of the preview estimate.
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview estimated Q4 ARPMAU at “~$0.127.”
